status: PRE-REGISTERED, NOT RUN (needs model adapter with usage reporting = paid resource -> budget mandate M9; independent evaluator per CE-02 gate)

arms.S: static agent: fixed instructions, no memory, no learning
arms.M: S + growing experience memory (existing candidate store records appended to context)
arms.E: S + strategy evolution (candidates, shadow evaluation, governed adoption)
arms.R: E + regret guidance (RSE-01) + adaptive procedure distillation + context activation + mode selection (direct/reflect/cooperate/explore)

tasks.families: CE-01 task families (diagnosis, architecture, tool choice, contradictory evidence) as RECURRING instances: 4 families x 12 instances, presented in a fixed seeded order
tasks.transfer: CE-01 X1/X2 families x 6 instances after the learning phase

controls.information: identical task material; M/E/R only add what they learned themselves in this run
controls.budget: no per-arm token cap during tasks (cost is the outcome), hard cap 2x static-arm median per task to prevent runaway

measures.quality: frozen scorer v2.1 + provenance verifier on structured answers; rubric items by blinded independent judges
measures.tokens: input+output tokens per task from the adapter's usage report (not estimated)
measures.learning_cost: tokens + ms + human minutes spent in reflection, distillation, shadow evaluation and approval, attributed to the cycle
measures.tco: sum(task tokens * price) + learning_cost money + human approval minutes * rate (rates fixed below)
measures.regressions: RSE-01 HURT count per arm vs S on identical instances
measures.memory_growth: bytes and prompt tokens of memory/procedures carried into each task, per instance index
measures.break_even: breakEven(): smallest n of recurring instances where cumulative TCO(arm) <= TCO(S), defined only if quality_delta >= 0 and HURT == 0

rates.pricePerMTok: list price of the chosen model on run date, recorded in the run manifest

hard_limits: efficiency is promoted only via efficiencyDecision(): no regression, no quality drop, no calibration drop > 0.02
risk=high tasks always run in reflect mode
decision_rule: R is more efficient than E iff median tokens/task over instances 7-12 is lower by >= 15% in >= 2 of 3 seeds AND quality not lower AND HURT == 0; break-even reported per arm with 95% bootstrap interval

comparison.GUARD: external reference only. Source NOT found in any reachable repository or handoff (unverified). If the owner supplies the publication/results, effect sizes are compared descriptively after the run; GUARD results are never used as targets or priors
